# Poseidon Network Systems

> IT support, network infrastructure, and Dell hardware provider based in Sea Point, Cape Town, South Africa. Serving businesses and homes across the Western Cape since 2004.

## About
Poseidon Network Systems is a Cape Town-based IT services company offering managed IT support, network setup and cabling, new and refurbished Dell hardware (Authorized Dell Partner), device repairs and maintenance, consumables, and business continuity/backup solutions.

## Key facts
- Founded: 2004
- Location: Sea Point, Cape Town, South Africa, 8005
- Phone: 021 300 8278
- WhatsApp: 064 702 9962
- Hours: Monday–Friday, 07:30–17:30
- Hardware positioning: refurbished Dell (with onsite warranty) for price-conscious clients, new Dell for brand-aware buyers, and other IT hardware sourced on request
